Filecoin Double Deposited on Binance
Filecoin, a cryptocurrency for digital storage on the blockchain, has a serious security flaw when depositing on exchanges. A deposit of 61,000 Filecoin was made on Binance. The end result was around 120,000 FIL, indicating that there is a clear problem in this scenario. The user got double what they deposited. Due to an overlooked flaw in the remote procedure call used by the coin when making a deposit, it was possible to essentially double-spend a deposit to an exchange. Traders could start a deposit and send the funds to Binance. If the transaction was taking its time, one could increase the fee with a replace-by-fee transaction. Instead of rejecting the initial transaction though, Binance credited both due to the flaw. >>Source


Visa Plans to Support Spending Bitcoin
Following Bitcoin's explosive growth at the start of 2021, many financial companies have been racing to release cryptocurrency integrations with their products and services. Visa has been looking at ways to give their card users the ability to spend Bitcoin and stablecoins on the go. During a podcast, Al Kelly, Visa's CEO, revealed that the financial services giant is trying to do two things. The first aim "is to enable the purchase of bitcoin on Visa credentials." The second, more exciting aim, involves the corporation "working with bitcoin wallets to allow the bitcoin to be translated into a fiat currency." This would mean that customers would be able to use their Visa card at 70 million places around the world and pay with Bitcoin anywhere. >>Source

I'm Standing on a Million Lives Season 2 Anime's Video Reveals More Cast, Ending Song Artist
A new promotional video of the anime Naoki Yamakawa of the mange Akinari Nao's I'm Standing on a Million Lives (100-Man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru) related to the second season of the anime was revealed on Friday by the official website of the series. The video revealed the endthing theme song and some new cast members. >>Source

Digimon Adventure: Anime Unveils New Video, Visual
Toei Animation revealed on Friday two new promotional videos for Digimon Adventure: anime. The videos tease the story that is getting closer and closer to the ending of it and also the anime's insert song "Break the chain" by Takayoshi Tanimoto. This is some very exciting news. We will be getting more content and storyline of the original Digimon Adventure series most of us grew up watching. >>Source

Butt Detective Anime Gets New Episodes on April 3 After 10-Month Break
The anime Butt Detective (Oshiri Tantie) did not receive new episodes since June 2020. It was finally announced on Thursday that the anime will soon get new episodes on NHK's E Tele channel, beginning on April 3. This was the longest break between episodes for this anime. The website also revealed new cast members and visuals. >>Source

Bakugan: Geogan Rising Anime Premieres in Japan in April
It was announced on Friday that Bakugan: Geogan Rising will premiere in Japan in April on the official Japanese Twitter account for the franchise. Spin Master describes Bakugan: Geogan Rising:
"Bakugan: Geogan Rising sees hero Dragonoid return as the Awesome Brawlers remain in a deep slumber, healing from the last time they had to save the world. This time, the gang will face adventures with a new set of Bakugan characters including Geogan, a Bakugan-like creature fused with elements of crystals and forming a new geometric form. Not only do Geogans look different than their Bakugan counterparts, but they are exceptionally strong and built to brawl. It's not long before the Awesome Brawlers turn this group of misfit Bakugan into loyal partners, and Geogan have arrived on the scene, ready to prove their worth and dominate in the Bakugan battle arena." >>Source
